summary: Tested the two new features: GET /api/mood/weekly and the Mood AI 'Bagikan ke WhatsApp' share button. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass against the preview URL — guest returns authenticated:false with 7 empty days (Sen/Sel/Rab/Kam/Jum/Sab/Min), exactly one is_today=true and it is the last element, total/active_days 0, top null; auth Asha returns authenticated:true with seed data reflected (total>=2, active_days>=2, top with key/label/emoji, per-day dominant with key/label/emoji when count>0); inserting a mood_logs row for a different user (Budi) via psql does not change Asha's totals and does appear in Budi's weekly; POST /api/mood/recommend increments today's bar for the authenticated user by exactly 1. Regression on /api/health, /api/home, /api/me (auth), /api/moods all 200. Frontend at 390px: (1) Guest home shows home-mood-chart-guest 'Masuk untuk melihat grafik mood' with home-mood-chart-cta -> /mood; (2) Logged-in Asha shows home-mood-chart-top ('⚡ Berenergi · 3/7 hari check-in · 8 kali'), 7 home-mood-bar-<YYYY-MM-DD> elements, today's bar styled with var(--nv-accent) (terracotta) at 100% height; (3) New user Citra shows home-mood-chart-empty; (4) /mood submit mood-ask-ai-btn then mood-ai-result renders mood-ai-share-btn 'Bagikan ke WhatsApp' which calls window.open with https://wa.me/?text=... and the decoded text contains the headline and item names. No console errors, no horizontal overflow on / or /mood.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mood_weekly: start-of-window uses datetime.combine(start - timedelta(days=1), ...) which fetches one extra prior day's rows unnecessarily; results are correctly filtered by per_day dict so no bug, but the window math can be tightened (use start directly in Asia/Jakarta).
MoodWeekChart hides entirely on fetch error (setData(null) -> returns null). Minor: consider showing a lightweight error affordance instead of a blank gap on home.
AiResult.buildShareText uses window.location.origin which breaks SSR but fine for CRA; acceptable.
test_credentials: Asha dev token in /app/memory/dev_token.txt; mint others via cd /app/backend && /root/.venv/bin/python scripts/dev_token.py <uuid> '<name>'
seed_data_creation: Inserted one mood_logs row for user 22222222-... (Budi) during isolation test, plus the per-run +1 for Asha (via /api/mood/recommend).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Weekly chart + WhatsApp share both working end-to-end. For future runs: dev token in /app/memory/dev_token.txt (24h), new-user Citra uuid 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333, Budi uuid 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222. Run backend tests: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> /root/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_mood_weekly.py -o addopts=''.
